answer: The vault lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the hollow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on time-locked work history, published publicly on failure, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The karst of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
